Hello Nono!

I love all of the illustrations you've made for me, so I've decided to send a request! ^_^ 

【characters】
▸ Fig: a small rabbit bard who lives in a village of small animal-like (獣耳) people, where she works part-time at a tavern. She is a tomboy who likes to sing and play music, be out in nature, and spend time with friends and her partner, Fuji. Fig has a very sunny and optimistic personality, and she's very talkative and friendly.

▸ Fuji: a cat boy who also lives in the animal village with Fig, and works as an engineer. He comes from a very successful family that owns an apple orchard, and all of his relatives are named after different types of apples. Fuji himself is more introverted and reserved, but he's very funny, smart, kind to others, and cares a lot about Fig. His favorite things are apples, learning new things, and hanging out with Fig.

【prompt】
I would like a scene depicting Fig and Fuji doing radio taiso (ラジオ体操 No. 1)! Every morning after waking up, Fig and Fuji do these exercises together to get their day started! I would like them to be wearing either simple exercise clothes or sleepwear, but I will leave that up to you. 

【activity use】
▸ for personal use, and possibly to post on SNS

【reference materials】
Fig: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ae_m-_iQPp0wRSCOalRl99a_dSaqSi5V?usp=sharing
